status: declared, not frozen, not started; frozen by FREEZE-MREG-RERUN.json only after maintainer approval
label: SUPPLEMENTARY RERUN - minimal rerun of the two M_reg supplement cells after the concurrent-activity non-conformity of the M supplement (REPORT-M-SUPPLEMENT.md section 7); does not replace, re-classify or extend any frozen v0.6.0 result

probe.note: the M supplement's probe revision 2 build (tooling 8e190f72, freeze 8faf37bb), read in place; not rebuilt

M_reg_supplement.question: the two M_reg cells of the M supplement, rerun under verified absence of automated host activity

rules.interval: paired log ratios ln(C/B); n=12 -> one-based order statistics r(3), r(10); n=24 -> r(7), r(18) (analyze_bc_qualification.summarize_metric, unchanged)
rules.classification: PASS if upper <= ln(1+t); REGRESSION if lower > ln(1+t); else INCONCLUSIVE. For higher-is-better metrics the ratio is B/C. IMPROVED is reported (never claimed otherwise) only when the upper bound is below 0.
rules.M_reg: 12 analyzed pairs after 2 warmup pairs, a fresh server process per observation, arm order balanced; throughput tolerance primary 10% (ratio B/C), client p99 tolerance query_tail 25%
rules.validity: a configuration record is VALID only if errors == 0, item_errors is empty, noop_mutations == 0 and, with background activity, background.failures == 0 and background.completed > 0. 503 refusals are allowed and reported (admission limit 32 pending jobs). For M_reg every analyzed observation must also have only status 200 (unchanged analyzer). An invalid record is reported as invalid, never rerun or dropped; an M_reg cell with any invalid analyzed observation gets no verdict (INVALID).
rules.interpretation: Supplementary verdicts are reported beside the frozen ones. They never replace or re-classify a frozen verdict and grant no waiver; their use is the maintainer's decision.
rules.no_extension: no extension and no rerun, except one rerun of a child for a documented infrastructure failure unrelated to the measured code
rules.no_waiver_inheritance: No v0.4.0 or v0.5.0 maintainer waiver applies. A repeated failure is a v0.6.0 failure until the maintainer decides otherwise for v0.6.0 explicitly.
rules.conformance: Before measuring: no process matching the activity pattern (git, cargo, rustc, Antigravity IDE, Visual Studio Code) and a 300 s quiet period in which the host-activity monitor records none; otherwise the run does not start. During measuring: the monitor samples the process table every 0.2 s; a child whose interval [start, start+duration+1 s] overlaps a recorded matching process is NON-CONFORMING, and a cell with a non-conforming analyzed observation gets no verdict (NONCONFORMING). After measuring: FETCH_HEAD mtimes and remote-tracking reflog lengths of every Git clone under /Users/rt/workspace/knotrel are compared with the pre-run snapshot (read only); any change during the run makes the whole run NONCONFORMING.
rules.outcome_commitment: The rerun's outcome is reported whatever it is (PASS, INCONCLUSIVE, REGRESSION, INVALID or NONCONFORMING). There is no further rerun of these cells for v0.6.0 without a new maintainer decision. Its verdicts are supplementary and never replace frozen verdicts or close other non-PASS items.

host_conditions.power: AC (pmset -g batt reports 'AC Power'); checked before every cell; a cell on battery invalidates the run
host_conditions.thermal: pmset -g therm recorded before every cell; any recorded thermal or performance warning invalidates the cell
host_conditions.concurrency: no cargo/rustc process and no other campaign; checked before each experiment
host_conditions.automated_activity: Antigravity IDE and Visual Studio Code closed (or their Git auto-fetch disabled and evidence/ removed from their workspaces) by the operator before the run; verified by the pre-run gate and the monitor, not assumed

invalidation.code_change: any change to executed code of knotrel after freezing invalidates every experiment that ran that code; documentation-only commits do not (executed code identity is checked by comparing __TEXT,__text of release builds)
invalidation.tooling_change: any change to a probe, collector or analysis after freezing invalidates the affected experiment
invalidation.failed_child: a failing child stops the experiment; one rerun only for an infrastructure failure unrelated to the measured code, recorded with its cause
invalidation.invalid_runs: kept and reported; never deleted or overwritten (collectors refuse to overwrite)
